title: Generate bounded progressive-disclosure context map
objective: Generate and validate a concise startup context index from canonical project state, the single active AWU, its deterministic context route and the current handoff so a fresh agent knows exactly what to read first and what not to load by default.
non_goals: scan the whole repository at startup

required_invariants: AGENTS.md and config/governance/project_state.json are the first two startup authorities
context map active lot task manifest and AWU exactly match canonical state and resolver output
context map execution route exactly reuses the deterministic AWU primary/reference route instead of inventing a second router
engineering/handoff/CURRENT.json is explicit resume context but never overrides canonical state
context map paths are unique repository-relative existing control-plane files
historical evidence and business implementation files are not part of the default startup route
map size and routed context remain within the active AWU risk budget
generation and validation are offline standard-library zero-cost
acceptance_criteria: generated JSON and Markdown are deterministic and --check detects staleness
fresh-agent startup order is explicit and begins AGENTS then project_state
active manifest and active AWU are explicitly named
primary/reference route matches validate_awu_context output byte-for-byte by path order
handoff active task mismatch fails closed
duplicate path or repository-escape path fails closed
chat history and engineering/STATE.json are explicitly marked non-authoritative for startup
bootstrap validates the generated context map without network or external packages

done_when: a fresh agent can identify exact startup read order and bounded execution context from repository files alone
context routing remains a single deterministic mechanism
no whole-repository read is required for ordinary continue-development startup
